title: Eleven of Wikipedia's principles proposed for AGENTS.md in the ontologist's story 'What Wikipedia knows about being right' (/articles/what-wikipedia-knows-about-being-right/): the burden on the one who adds, one claim one assertion, say where you read it, breaking news as primary, the ten-year test, words to watch as a gate warning, contradictions on both claims' pages, edit summaries that name the source, one revert then the board, the edit-request shape for cross-scope asks, a six-point page review. Two are build rules the ontologist would write (2, 6); the rest are AGENTS.md paragraphs or desk work. For the conductor and the editor to take or leave.
